project_type: Express.js TypeScript backend + React TypeScript frontend with Vite, Supabase PostgreSQL, RLS-enforced multi-tenant SaaS
build_system: npm workspaces, backend: tsc, frontend: Vite
test_framework: None currently implemented (automated tests are a known gap per README.md)
build_command: backend: cd backend && npm run build; frontend: cd frontend && npm run build
test_command: No automated tests exist - manual verification via dev servers and browser testing required
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: cd backend && npm run dev (runs on port from .env, typically 3000). 2. Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev (runs on :5173). 3. Test via browser with patient credentials. 4. Verify TypeScript compilation: npm run build in both backend/ and frontend/.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/dist/ contains compiled JS from TypeScript - generated by tsc, not checked in per .gitignore
environment_constraints: Migrations must be applied to Supabase database manually (no automated migration runner). Backend requires SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in backend/.env. Frontend requires VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in frontend/.env. Patients table has NO user_id column - must add via migration to link Supabase Auth users to patient records.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md is absolute authority: (1) No file >100 lines - extract early. (2) TypeScript strict, no 'any'. (3) Raw HTML only in frontend/src/components/ui/. (4) Zero direct Supabase calls in frontend - all via api client. (5) Migrations are sequential/immutable - next is 0024. (6) Permission keys are 'domain.action'. (7) Every hospital-scoped route needs requireHospitalPermission middleware. (8) No role inheritance. (9) Patients are hospital-agnostic (no hospital_id on patients table). (10) DRY: extract on second occurrence. (11) One file one responsibility.
key_patterns: Backend routes: one file per domain in backend/src/routes/, handler functions in separate .handlers.ts co-located file or inline, services in backend/src/services/. Permission check via requireHospitalPermission(PERMISSIONS.KEY) middleware. Routes defined in backend/src/constants/routes.ts. Frontend: pages in frontend/src/pages/<domain>/, hooks in use<Name>.ts, components under components/ folder per page, ui primitives in frontend/src/components/ui/, API calls via frontend/src/lib/api.ts ApiClient class. React Query for data fetching. Context for auth (AuthContext) and hospital selection (HospitalContext).
directory_structure: backend/src/: server.ts (entry), app.ts (router mounting), config/ (env, supabase), middleware/ (auth, requireHospitalPermission, errorHandler), services/ (AuthorizationService, domain services), routes/ (one per API section), constants/ (permissions, roles, routes, statuses), utils/ (respond). frontend/src/: main.tsx (entry), App.tsx (root), AppRoutes.tsx (routing), components/ui/ (raw HTML wrappers), components/common/ (shared components), components/layout/ (Header, MainLayout), pages/<domain>/ (page components with local components/ and hooks/ folders), contexts/ (AuthContext, HospitalContext), lib/ (api.ts, supabase.ts, config.ts, hooks/, utils/), services/ (domain API service wrappers), types/, constants/.
